parsed.headline: Denied: No in-person follow-up visit within six months documented.
parsed.explanation: This claim is denied because it does not meet the requirement: "Every six (6) months following the initial prescription of the CGM, the treating practitioner has an in-person visit with the beneficiary to assess adherence to their CGM regimen and diabetes treatment plan." The record does not show an in-person follow-up visit within the required six-month period.
parsed.what_to_do: Submit documentation of an in-person follow-up visit within six months if available, or correct and resubmit the claim if appropriate.
